data.name: Eswaran
data.long_meaning: Eswaran is a name derived from the Sanskrit word 'Eshwara', which means 'Lord of the Universe'. In Hindu mythology, Eshwara is a form of Shiva, the God of destruction and regeneration. This name is often given to a child born on a Tuesday, as Tuesday is considered a lucky day for Shiva devotees.
